title: Innkeeper's Basement
description:
What is this game about?Explore the cursed dungeon of Innkeeper's Basement in this minesweeper-inspired roguelite: Use cards from your deck to destroy enemies, interact with special objects and journey deeper on the increasingly difficult levels!
Inspired bySlay the Spire, Runestone Keeper, Desktop Dungeons & Minesweeper, among others.How to play?First, create your Character...Try over 5100 character combinations, each one with a different starting deck, stats, buffs and / or debuffs!
Next, select the Dungeon...Choose one of the 12 unique Dungeons, each one with different goals!
...and start your Adventure! :)With minesweeper-inspired exploration! :)
ControlsMouse is all you need to play the game. Use "WSAD" for easier navigation and hotkeys below the cards (1,2,3,4...) for faster gameplay!Build up your deck as you play!Every run will give you new cards and items to modify your deck and stats / buffs during gameplay!
Oh, the game also has *Tons* of unlocks...• 13+ Dungeons

• 16+ Character Races

• 24+ Character Classes 

• 10+ Constellations

• many Cards, Enemies and other in-game elements

Enjoy! :)Join our Discord server!Interesting factAll art in game was AI-generated (not counting placeholders).
description_short: Innkeeper's Basement is a challenging roguelike card game mixed with minesweeper with over 5000 different character build combinations. Create your character, explore the dungeon, build your deck, drink alcohol to forget bad decisions and vanquish monsters!
